_: FITLOG_SLEEP_P2_PAGE. Against the reconstructed v1.6.0 app.py there is
no Sleep card at all, the tables say 'Rest HR' rather than 'Rest HR
overnight', the strip does not say where those figures come from, and
the watch feed carries no night.
Three assertions guard properties that build ALSO satisfied -- a page
with no sleep display scores no night, shows no mean where a median was
promised, and sets no small type in rules it does not have. A version
control cannot make any of them fail for the right reason, so each is
broken on purpose in a copy of the current build instead.
M_score     -- put a sleep score on the card. THIS IS THE ONE THAT
MATTERS. He has post-discontinuation insomnia and a
number graded every morning becomes its own cause; the
whole record is built so that this cannot appear.
M_mean      -- show the mean where the card promises a median, so one
bad night drags the comparison. Assertion 11.
M_smalltype -- set 12px type in a new rule. Assertion 12.

assertions.name: 01 the Sleep card renders and names the night
02 the night is shown in hours and minutes
03 the night's clock times are IST
04 the stage split is named and drawn to scale
05 breaks and measured awake time are separate
06 an overnight figure is averaged over the night
07 a figure not measured inside the night says so
08 resting HR and HRV are labelled as derived overnight
09 the Today-so-far strip says Rest HR and HRV are overnight
13 the watch feed carries the whole night
10 the page never scores, grades or ranks a night

mutation.why: a sleep score is put on the card -- the single thing this whole record is built to prevent

assertions.name: 11 the only comparison is his own median

mutation.why: the mean is shown where the card promises a median, so one bad night drags the figure he is compared with

assertions.name: 12 nothing added here sets type below 14px

mutation.why: a new rule is set to 12px, which is the size this page is not allowed to use
